label: Category
meaning: Level 1: catalogue category (source). Level 2: name-head sub-category (derived).

label: DataSource
meaning: A provenance source the workbook declares (plus the project brief it cites).

label: LegacyReference
meaning: A previous part number of the same part, or an unresolved free-text note.

label: Machine
meaning: A machine MODEL from the catalogue (one row per model). Not a serial-numbered unit; units do not exist in the data.

label: MachineFamily
meaning: Family derived from the model-code prefix. Needs business confirmation.

label: OrderStatus
meaning: Workflow status vocabulary from the brief.

label: PartSpecification
meaning: Verbatim spec note or a value parsed from it.

label: Plant
meaning: A plant declared fictional by the project brief.
